displayName: OCI-AI-DB-019: AI — RAG Denial of Service via Document Flooding
description:
Detects denial-of-service attacks through flooding RAG document stores with junk data

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — rag denial of service via document flooding

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_019", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%rag%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%denial%') AND "value" > 0
